name: GPT-4o mini TTS
access: OpenAI API (Audio speech endpoint, POST /v1/audio/speech; HTTP, SDKs and CLI)

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, plus an optional instructions string that steers delivery. The instructions field does not work on tts-1 or tts-1-hd [o-ref-speech]
voice.output_audio: mp3 (the default), opus, aac, flac, wav and pcm; PCM is headerless 24 kHz, 16-bit signed, little-endian. OpenAI advises wav or pcm for the fastest response. Streaming uses chunked audio or server-sent events (stream_format audio or sse) [o-guide-tts] [o-ref-speech]
voice.voices: 13 built-in voices, optimised for English: alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer, verse, marin and cedar (the guide's first paragraph says 11, and its list gives 13). OpenAI recommends marin or cedar. Custom voices are made from a consent recording and an audio sample of up to 30 seconds, for approved customers only, with at most 20 per organisation. Voices made from a text prompt work only in Live, not on this endpoint [o-guide-tts] [o-ref-speech] [o-custom-voices]
languages: Follows the Whisper language list, 57 languages from Afrikaans to Welsh; the voices are optimised for English and the input text sets the language [o-guide-tts]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model. The pages read describe no barge-in or cancel message; the client stops playback (inferred) [o-guide-tts]
voice.latency: OpenAI publishes no time-to-first-audio figure for this model. Its guide says wav or pcm give the fastest response. Artificial Analysis has a page for the model but shows no Elo or speed for it [o-guide-tts] [aa-4o]
voice.session_limit: Input up to 4,096 characters per request by the API reference; the model page gives a limit of 2,000 input tokens. No output duration limit is stated [o-ref-speech] [o-model]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per token [o-pricing] [o-model]. The input field is the text rate and the output field is the audio rate. The pages read give no price per minute of speech. The older tts-1 costs US$15 and tts-1-hd US$30 per 1M characters [o-pricing]. OpenAI removes all four speech synthesis ids on 2027-01-06 [o-depr].

benchmarks.name: RW-Voice-EQ Bench, Acoustic Quality (human Likert mean)
benchmarks.setting: five-point Likert mean, default voice (alloy) and default settings, id gpt-4o-mini-tts (the paper dates it 2025-03-20 and does not say which snapshot ran); tied with Fish Audio S2 for second place of 31 configurations. The paper says the model is in the top five of three of its seven TTS dimensions. A paper by a speech vendor

unknown: generation: OpenAI gives no generation number; the model has two dated snapshots, 2025-03-20 and 2025-12-15
max_output: no output limit is published in tokens or seconds
pricing_usd_per_mtok.cached_input: the pricing page lists no cached rate for the model
system_card: OpenAI published no system card or model card for the model in the pages read
Artificial Analysis speech arena: the model has a page on the site but no Elo, because the model is not rated there [aa-4o]
